name: FreshLoot: Per-Player Loot
statusMeaning: In the catalogue, not checked yet.
author: Jahus
description: Is a player not entitled to his loot? Now, every player gets his own loot when opening a chest. Destroying a chest to prevent others from looting it is shameful. Fair per-player loot for SMP and multiplayer servers. No more first-come-first-served looting.
evidence: Server-side mod: Kiln runs mods' code on Horizon's single-player server, not on dedicated servers. Everything its code calls is covered by Kiln development build 2026-11-26 (cdf45c68) (50 classes, 93 members). Not run yet.

softOff.why: only events, HUD, keys, commands and guarded mixin handlers
